question: Identify male patients who have had at least two laboratory tests showing abnormal IgM levels (outside the normal range of 40–400) and whose first recorded medical data was before the year 2010. Return their patient ID, age, and the number of abnormal IgM test records they have, ordered by age in ascending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    p."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
    p."XCL_060" AS age,
    COUNT(l."XCL_014") AS abnormal_igm_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND NOT l."XCL_044" BETWEEN 40 AND 400
  AND p."XCL_062" < '2010-01-01'
GROUP BY p."XCL_058", p."XCL_060"
HAVING COUNT(l."XCL_014") >= 2
ORDER BY p."XCL_060" ASC

    p."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
    p."XCL_060" AS age,
    COUNT(l."XCL_014") AS abnormal_igm_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND NOT l."XCL_044" BETWEEN 40 AND 400
  AND p."XCL_062" < '2010-01-01'
GROUP BY p."XCL_058", p."XCL_060"
HAVING COUNT(l."XCL_014") >= 2
ORDER BY p."XCL_060" ASC

       (julyage(p."XCL_060")) AS age,
       COUNT(l."XCL_014") AS abnormal_igm_count

WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'M'
